answer: Operator-Linked Identity Quarantine. Each new wallet attaches to a persistent operator record via signed challenge. If any wallet on a record is flagged for duplicate behavior, every wallet on that record enters a cooldown, and the operator must post a marble-sealed collateral deposit to resume. Repeat flags escalate fees per linked wallet; persistent abuse freezes the whole record at a nebula-tier penalty. Each identity thus costs a rising real deposit, not gas. The jetty limit is three resets per operator per year.
